scope: SYNTHETIC_TEST_PREPARATION; NO PRODUCTION CODE OR PROOF
authority_note: Project authority supplies formulas/IDs; existing family packets are reused rather than reconstructed. Structured values are controlled synthetic fixtures only; unresolved model and carrier decisions not fabricated.

steps: 1. Instantiate exactly the controlled source records/history and verified contract variants stated in the selected family packet; do not run the calculation in setup.
2. Verify each selected raw occurrence is eligible under its temporal kind, subject, version and knowledge cutoff; materialise actual public predecessor D occurrences separately where required.
3. Before calculation, observe absence of this D occurrence on the public read seam; no helper may precreate it.
4. Invoke the independently implemented public D selection/calculation operation and assert the exact equation result or the precise model/representation hold.
5. Read immutable first-write/identity/lineage and retry without mutation, then, when the M02 owner/storage profile is admitted, read in a fresh process/SQLite connection.

6. Restore the valid positive preconditions and mutate precisely the specified negative dimension; assert the intended refusal reaches its selector without writing, preserving already observed history.
7. Challenge cross-ID/source-version hash binding, a disallowed stale/wrong-subject record, and a paginated-history fault only if the admitted per-ID contract applies.

rules.initial_state: A disposable empty owner-local test database and versioned controlled fixture sources; NEVER reuse production or precreate the derived fact.
rules.subject: A fixed per-signal synthetic identity; keep all raw/predecessor observations on that same subject and config version unless intentionally testing mismatch.
rules.clock_kind: Respect the native temporal_kind from per-R source record; date_only is not implicitly true_instant. For controlled instants supply explicit UTC aware date-time, cutoff and received times.
rules.cursor_safety: Any injected cursor/page fault must have at least one valid real source page/projection at the required offset before injection; never exhaust finite native history before the intended fault.
rules.source_provenance: Synthetic input; Gate 1 source records describe candidate native profiles only. No provider certification is asserted.
